valore: Riga 416: 'Normalisation (173-329x), an element-wise operation limited by memory bandwidth rather than by arithmetic, had the largest speedup at every size, and neighbour graph construction (44-88x) benefited strongly from the GPU.' seguita dalla frase D-16/P3 sui vicini.
motivo: 'benefited most' non regge per i vicini: a 100k vengono dopo HVG (94.2x), DE (87.5x) e UMAP (45.3x); con D-16 e P3 lo speedup corretto a 100k (17.9x) e' sotto la PCA.

valore: Riga 422: 'From 50,000 cells upwards, however, GPU Leiden labels differed between repeats with a fixed seed in at least one GPU configuration at each size, while CPU labels did not, and other studies report CPU-GPU adjusted Rand indices of about 0.5 for clustering of up to 1.3 million cells [@Nolet2022; @Gardner2025]; ...'
motivo: 'GPU Leiden labels varied across repeats' a 50k e oltre non vale per ogni configurazione (gpu2 a 50k ha un solo hash su 5 ripetizioni a tutte e tre le risoluzioni); Gardner riporta ARI circa 0.5 a tutte le dimensioni, non solo 'at large sizes'.

valore: Riga 412: '...shortened the standard Scanpy pipeline by about one to two orders of magnitude, with speedups that grew with dataset size within each configuration ... processed up to 11.9 million cells (12.0 million with chunked preprocessing), ...'
motivo: Lo speedup minimo in Table 4 e' 8.0x (gpu4 a 10k, 10^0.91); la crescita con la dimensione vale dentro ogni configurazione ma non fra configurazioni (34.9x a 500k con 2 GPU < 43.8x a 100k con 1 GPU); la variante chunked ha completato 12.0M.

valore: Riga 418: versione senza cifre di PCA/vicini e data loading (rimando ai Risultati), con 'in jobs that ran concurrently, the 8-GPU jobs on a different node', piu' la frase di R0539.
motivo: Il piano stesso (R0581 e R0659) mette le cifre nel paragrafo dei Risultati di R0352; la Discussione non le ripete.

valore: Riga 424: 'In the memory-optimised pipeline we tested, GPU VRAM did not limit the number of cells; ScaleSC [@Hu2025] and Dicks et al. [@Dicks2026] reach larger datasets with chunked or out-of-core preprocessing, so the limit we observed belongs to the pipeline rather than to GPU analysis in general.'
motivo: Il piano scrive che la memoria CPU durante il preprocessing Scanpy ha limitato il numero di cellule; i log SLURM non lo mostrano: a 12,000,000 il job 16531 (sacct COMPLETED) ha completato fino ai vicini e si e' fermato con un TimeoutError alla chiusura di Dask; a 13,745,880 exit -9 senza messaggio di OOM.

valore: Riga 424: 'The single run at 12.0M cells stopped with a timeout while the Dask cluster was shut down after neighbour search, so it does not show where the memory limit lies; the runs at 13.7M cells were killed by the system (signal 9) without an out-of-memory message, and our between-step sampling of the parent process cannot show whether transient allocations exceeded the SLURM cgroup limit (Table 6).'
motivo: 'The 12M-cell failure did not coincide with an exhausted average allocation' presuppone un fallimento per memoria che il log non registra (vedi R0595). Unita' in GiB (trappola 8).

valore: Riga 424: '...reduced aggregate VRAM by a factor of five (48.8 GiB to 9.6 GiB) and completed 12.0M cells (it was killed at 15.0M), while host RAM reached 862 GiB, which confirms that GPU memory was not the binding resource in this pipeline.'
motivo: 'raised the limit from 11.9M' presuppone che 12.0M fosse il limite della pipeline memory-optimised, ma quel run non e' fallito per memoria; unita' in GiB; 15.0M verificato nel log SLURM 16825 (exit 137).

valore: Riga 437: 'In a stress test on replicated copies of a 3.4M-cell dataset, a single DGX H100 node completed 11.9M cells (12.0M with chunked preprocessing) while the recorded GPU memory stayed at 7.6% of the total, so GPU memory did not set the limit.'
motivo: Come R0595: il limite oltre 11.9M non e' attribuibile alla memoria CPU con i dati registrati; variante chunked completata a 12.0M.
